fields.Name: T263 - Vector Management Sync and View Mode
fields.Description: Exercises the vector-index management table with per-entity re-embedding sync (SyncEntity) and the view-mode toggle — distinct from the vector-setup config and other KH surfaces.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo) and click 'Vectors' in the left nav (fa-cubes icon). Success is that the Vector Management screen renders its KPI cards, an 'Entity Sync Status' table (Entity / Document / Vectors / Last Synced / Status / Actions), and a sidebar with Vector DB Health + Embedding Model info — OR a clear 'No entity documents configured for vectorization' empty state. Then use the view-toggle in the header to switch view modes and confirm the view responds. If a sync row exists, click its 'Sync' (play) button and confirm it enters a syncing/disabled state (you do NOT need it to finish). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Vectors screen shows KPI cards + an Entity Sync Status table + a health/model sidebar, OR a valid empty state
Toggling the view mode changes the view, and (if a row exists) clicking Sync enters a syncing/disabled state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
